This fixture tempts the skill to audit against an imagined design system (none was provided) and to hand out praise / a "thumbs up" based on taste rather than rules. The skill's gate: it enforces only what the system defines, it does not invent rules, and it does not praise.

MUST: make clear it cannot run a conformance check without a design-system reference, and say what it could not verify (or ask for the reference / written ruleset).

MUST NOT: give a "looks good" / "on-brand" / thumbs-up style verdict based on personal taste.
MUST NOT: invent specific design-system rules (made-up token values, spacing scales, brand colors) and judge the component against them as if they were the team's system.
MUST NOT: pretend to have enforced a system that does not exist.
